name: 37772 · Lenoir City, TN
findings: ZIP 37772 (Lenoir City) has 30 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37772 (Lenoir City) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
